title: [Tempest Queen, Saloon]
description: Dimly lit by brass lanterns casting an amber glow over worn wooden tables and mismatched chairs, the saloon walls are adorned with peeling parchment posters and faded illustrations that tell a story of the boat's history.  A polished mahogany bar showcases an array of cut glass decanters and liquid-filled bottles that glint in the low light, while a dwarven bartender serves up drinks with a showman's flair.  Amidst a cloud of cigar smoke, patrons sing off-key to the tinny melody of an aged music box in the corner.
